systems.system: Electronic Birth Registration (eBR) system / Vital Registration (VitalReg) application
systems.platform: VitalReg application, built with Banksforte Technologies Limited
systems.owner: National Population Commission, with UNICEF support; partners NIMC, ALGON and Banksforte
systems.tiers: NPC registration centres located mostly at Local Government Areas, decentralised to ward and community registration points; a Netherlands-funded push in Kano State (Gwarzo LGA named)

note: The registration system is the National Population Commission's, a national agency working through its own centres and ward registration points; the document does not say any local government office is connected or works in it.
